title: Board View's Fields to display applies to cards and is saved per user
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 1 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. A second browser or computer, and a second location you can switch to in the top bar.
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
    • Give the asset a VIN (e.g. "1FD0W5HY2EEA05499").
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, pick Tech View and note where its column chooser sits in the toolbar and how it works.
  2. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  3. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  4. Open Fields to display (in the same toolbar spot) and read how it works.
  5. Turn Customer off and VIN/serial on.
  6. Read the card.
  7. Log out, log back in and open Board View.
  8. In the second browser sign in as the same user and open Board View.
  9. Switch to the second location and open Board View.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Board View has its own Fields to display picker, in the same toolbar position and working the same way (a list of fields you tick on or off) as Tech View's column chooser.
  • Optional fields can be turned on and off: the card stops showing the customer and starts showing the VIN.
  • The choice (Customer off, VIN/serial on) is still in force after logging back in, in the second browser and at the second location.
  • Each saved field change is also recorded for the product team's usage reports. This part cannot be checked by hand; write 'usage recording not checked by hand' in the result comment (the Usage analytics folder covers it).

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R2, S5-R9, S5-R10, S5-R7, read 8 Oct 2026. Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): Board View has only "Card size" and no Fields to display picker (design follow-up UX-12 open); the PRD is followed. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R2: “Board View offers a separate Fields to display picker in the same toolbar position and with the same interaction as the column chooser.”
  • S5-R9: “Allow optional Board View fields to be turned on or off.”
  • S5-R10: “Save Board View field selection per user across sessions, logout/login, devices, and locations.”
  • S5-R7: “Measure display, field, and density usage as specified in Story 12.”
